messages.author: 6f9739ea511c7a89
messages.subject: Passing objects via source()
parts:
Team Shiny,

When I use source() to include another .R file, objects created before the source() line are not getting passed to the sourced file.  E.g.,

server.R
new_data = dataframe
source("blah.R")

When blah.R references new_data created in my server.R script, it says the object new_data does not exist.

Thoughts?
